text: Input from worker-3: my 0l4q work already implements option (A)'s production behavior on the fix-dio-unicast-dis-0l4q worktree branch (heft): the unicast-DIS response path was changed from send_dio(source) (unadmittable unicast DIO) to the jittered multicast trickle response — commit e2adf9f3cf, with the multicast_dio_and_dis test migrated and passing under the unchanged gate. If (A) is chosen, that branch lands as-is for the DIO portion. If (B) is chosen (solicitation ledger + Python mirror + spec 09 text), the branch's DIS-response change needs reworking to unicast + ledger admission — flagging for Mark: this is an RFC 6550 8.3 SHOULD deviation decision, spec-text authority needed either way.
